rationale: The stock has already surged ~4.5% from the open low to current price in just 5 minutes, placing it at 89% of today's range and within 0.55% of the session high — the easy momentum move has largely played out. The bid-ask spread of 62 bps on a $1,225 stock creates significant friction, and with volume decelerating sharply on the last candle (10,499 vs prior candles of 19-37k), the immediate thrust appears to be exhausting. The negative governance investigation news adds downside tail risk that makes a long unattractive, while the violent upward reversal from the open makes a short equally dangerous near the high.
